news.body: The Carolina Panthers D/ST had a big day against the Atlanta Falcons, holding them to just three points in the 34-3 victory, racking up two fumble recoveries, three interceptions, including a pick-six, and three sacks.
news.head: Carolina Panthers D/ST bounce back in big win over Atlanta
news.impact: The Falcons' QB situation has been dire the last two weeks between Cooper Rush and Jack Strand, and the Panthers' took full advantage. They'll get another potentially easy matchup against Cleveland next week, but the Browns bounced back in their own way after their season-opening loss to Jacksonville.

news.body: The Panthers D/ST forced one turnover (one fumble recovery) while also recording two sacks in a 59-37 Week 1 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Panthers D/ST dismal in Week 1 loss
news.impact: The unit did not have many answers for an explosive Chicago offense in the season opener, allowing eight total touchdowns on 592 offensive yards, with six of those scores coming on the ground in the loss. The unit will look to get back on track against an Atlanta Falcons offense that could be forced to once again start quarterback Cooper Rush in Week 2.

news.body: The Panthers D/ST allowed 16 points on 338 total yards with one interception and two sacks in Week 18 against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Panthers D/ST allows 16 points in Week 18
news.impact: Baker Mayfield drove the Bucs offense down the field for a touchdown on the opening drive of the game. Carolina made the necessary adjustments to keep the team in the game through the end. They will take on the Rams at home next weekend in the Wild Card round.

news.body: The Panthers D/ST allowed 27 points on 288 total yards with one interception, one fumble recovery and three sacks on Sunday against Seattle.
news.head: Carolina Panthers D/ST forces two turnovers Sunday
news.impact: Carolina forced an interception and fumble of Sam Darnold. They nearly had another turnover or two as well. They will be needed to step up in Week 18 against Baker Mayfield and the Bucs offense.

news.body: The Bengals D/ST allowed 30 points, 292 passing yards, and 138 rushing yards in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers.
news.head: Bengals D/ST allows 30 points in Week 3 loss
news.impact: The Bengals' defense tallied two sacks and one interception in loss Sunday. They struggled to stop Jaylen Warren on the ground, as he averaged 7.5 yards per carry on the day. The defense will have a tough matchup against a strong Jacksonville offense in Week 4.

news.body: The Bengals D/ST allowed six points on 374 total yards with four sacks on Sunday against the Texans.
news.head: Bengals D/ST posts another strong performance Sunday
news.impact: It is the second straight strong performance to start the season for the Bengals defense. They will be on the streaming radar next week against Aaron Rodgers and the Steelers offense.

news.body: The Bengals D/ST allowed 20 points on 282 total yards with four sacks and four fumble recoveries on Sunday against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Bengals D/ST forces four fumbles Sunday
news.impact: The Bengals defense forced three fumbles of Baker Mayfield alone on Sunday and one on Bucky Irving. They will face CJ Stroud and the Texans in Week 2.

news.body: The Cincinnati Bengals D/ST racked up six sacks and a fumble recovery in the Bengals' 20-18 loss to the Browns.
news.head: Cincinnati Bengals D/ST rack up six sacks in loss
news.impact: The Bengals defense started to show some life in the back half of the season, finally picking up some slack where they had been one of the worst, if not the worst, units in the league. They will look to bring in some help and improve around names like DJ Turner and Trey Hendrickson next season and get back in the playoffs.

news.body: The Lions D/ST allowed 24 points, 321 passing yards, and 58 rushing yards in a 31-24 win over the Jets.
news.head: Lions D/ST allows 24 points in Week 3 win
news.impact: The Lions' defense tallied five sacks and forced a fumble from Geno Smith to seal the game late in the fourth quarter. The defense struggled against the pass, allowing an average of 8.7 yards per completion. The Lions will head to Carolina to take on the Panthers in Week 4.

news.body: The Lions' D/ST logged two sacks and allowed 41 points in Thursday night's loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Lions D/ST dismal in loss Thursday
news.impact: Detroit's defense looked terrible on Thursday night. They allowed Buffalo's offense to move the ball at will and gave up 41 points over the course of the night, which led to a loss for the team. They also looked poor against the Saints in Week 1, so this is shaping up to be a bad unit for the Lions, although we may get to see a better side to them with an easy schedule coming up over the next few weeks.

news.body: The Lions D/ST forced three turnovers (two interceptions, one fumble recovery) while also picking up five sacks in a 31-30 Week 1 win over the New Orleans Saints.
news.head: Lions D/ST stands tall in Week 1 win
news.impact: The unit escaped after allowing the Saints to come back from a 21-0 deficit in the second half, with New Orleans quarterback Tyler Shough overthrowing a potential game-winning two-point conversion in overtime. Fantasy managers will need to have another option available with a Week 2 matchup against the Buffalo Bills up next.

news.body: The Detroit Lions D/ST recorded just one sack and had one interception during the team's 19-16 win over the Bears in the last game of the year.
news.head: Detroit Lions D/ST quiet in season finale
news.impact: The Lions allowed only 270 yards of total offense to the Bears, marking the sixth-lowest total they have allowed in a game all season. However, they had trouble getting to Caleb Williams, sacking the quarterback just once. Avonte Maddox had the interception which led to a Lions' field goal late in the third quarter.

news.body: The Green Bay Packers D/ST managed an early interception before going quiet on the box score for the rest of the game in the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons.
news.head: Green Bay Packers D/ST run over by Atlanta in loss
news.impact: The Packers pulled off a pick four plays into the game, but didn't put anything else on the stat sheet afterwards. It was a dominant outing by the Falcons offense, with the Packers defense unable to stop Drake London or the ground game led by Bijan and Brian Robinson, who collectively averaged 5.9 yards per carry on the night. They'll look to be better next time out.

news.body: The Packers D/ST recorded four sacks in a 20-17 win over the New York Jets in Week 2.
news.head: Packers D/ST picks up four sacks in Week 2 win
news.impact: The unit made stops when it mattered to carry an inconsistent Green Bay offense, allowing 285 offensive yards in the win. The defense will look to take advantage of an underwhelming Atlanta Falcons offense in Week 3.

news.body: The Packers D/ST allowed 39 points on 239 total yards with three sacks and one interception.
news.head: Packers D/ST totals three sacks Sunday
news.impact: Green Bay held its own early despite still being without Micah Parsons. The Packers draw Geno Smith and the Jets next week.

news.body: The Green Bay Packers are hiring Jonathan Gannon as their new Defensive Coordinator.
news.head: Green Bay Packers hire Jonathan Gannon as DC
news.impact: Gannon was fired after an unsuccessful head coaching tenure in Arizona, but he lands in Green Bay with a promising unit led by Micah Parsons, who looks to return from injury during the middle of the 2026 season if not sooner.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 19 points, 235 passing yards, and 89 rushing yards in a loss to the Colts Sunday.
news.head: Texans D/ST allows 19 points in Week 3
news.impact: Houston's defense did a great job of keeping Jonathan Taylor in check, but allowed Daniel Jones to perform well enough to send the Texans to 0-3. The Texans will face Dallas in a tough matchup in Week 4.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 20 points on 267 total yards with five sacks on Sunday against the Bengals.
news.head: Texans D/ST totals five sacks Sunday
news.impact: Houston was able to get pressure on Joe Burrow all afternoon, but Ja'Marr Chase burned them for a pair of touchdowns. They will face Daniel Jones and the Colts next week.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 36 points on 409 yards of total offense while coming up with two sacks and no takeaways in Sunday's loss to the Bills.
news.head: Texans defense struggles to contain Bills in Week 1
news.impact: The Texans should feature a solid defensive unit this season, but they ran into a potent Bills' offense in Week 1. Powered by QB Josh Allen, the Bills shredded the Texans' pass defense, totaling 334 yards and a couple of scores through the air. Houston did come up with a couple of sacks, but Allen mostly had his way. The Texans will face another top-tier QB when Joe Burrow and the Bengals visit Houston in Week 2.

news.body: The Texans D/ST allowed 30 points on 354 total yards with one interception, one sack and fumble recoveries on Sunday against the Colts.
news.head: Texans D/ST recovers two fumbles in Week 18
news.impact: Houston sat its starters in the second half. They remain one of the top defenses in the NFL. They'll take on Aaron Rodgers and the Steelers in the Wild Card round.

news.body: The Chiefs' D/ST logged one interception and allowed 30 points in Sunday night's overtime win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Chiefs D/ST struggles in win Sunday
news.impact: Kansas City's defense didn't look good on Sunday night. They allowed Indianapolis to put up 30 points, and they weren't able to log a single sack or turnover beyond one interception. This unit should bounce back and look great in matchups against the Dolphins and Raiders over the next two weeks.

news.body: The Chiefs' D/ST logged four sacks and one interception while allowing just ten points in Monday night's win over the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Chiefs D/ST stellar in win Monday
news.impact: Kansas City was able to pick up a great win over their divisional rivals on Monday night. The performance of their defense had a lot to do with that, as they held Bo Nix and Co. to just ten points on the night and made numerous big plays to help out their offense. This is one of the league's best units at this point, and they will enjoy one of the league's easiest schedules over the next three weeks. They should be a waiver target in any league they are not currently rostered in.

news.body: The Chiefs D/ST allowed 105 passing yards, 118 rushing yards, and 14 points in the 14-12 loss to the Raiders.
news.head: Chiefs D/ST allows 14 points in Week 18
news.impact: The Chiefs' defense tallied three sacks, one interception, and one fumble recovery in the win. Despite a strong effort from the defense, the offense was unable to get enough points on the board to end the 2025 season with a win.

news.body: The Chiefs defense allowed 20 points on 303 yards of total offense, recording one sack and forcing one turnover in Thursday's loss to the Broncos.
news.head: Chiefs defense fares well in close loss Thursday night
news.impact: The Chiefs defense kept the contest close on Christmas night, but the KC offense ultimately could not do enough to pull off an upset. The unit has an attractive matchup waiting for the season finale in Las Vegas.

news.body: The Rams' D/ST logged two sacks and an interception while allowing just six points in Monday night's blowout win over the New York Giants.
news.head: Rams D/ST plays well in win Monday
news.impact: Los Angeles' defense looked good on Monday night. They held the Giants' offense to just six points on the night, but that was also aided by the multiple key injuries that New York suffered over the course of the night. This unit can be started in a matchup against the Broncos next week, although that is by no means an easy game for them.

news.body: The Los Angeles Rams' D/ST was completely destroyed by the 49ers' offense, and it didn't help that the Rams' offense was equally outmatched, making the final result all the more stark.
news.head: Los Angeles Rams D/ST run over by 49ers
news.impact: The Rams still have plenty of star talent on this side of the ball, so don't overreact to one week of football. They should be just fine as the season rolls along once they find their footing.

news.body: The Rams D/ST allowed 238 passing yards, 79 rushing yards, and 20 points in a 37-20 win over the Cardinals.
news.head: Rams D/ST allows 20 points in Week 18 win
news.impact: The Rams' defense tallied one interception, one fumble, and six sacks in the win. The Rams will head on the road to take on the NFC South champion Carolina Panthers in the first round of the playoffs.

news.body: The Los Angeles Rams D/ST allowed 27 points with no sacks or turnovers in the Rams 27-24 loss to the Falcons. They did however score a touchdown.
news.head: Los Angeles Rams D/ST has huge touchdown in loss
news.impact: The special teams unit came up big late in the loss to the Falcons thanks to a blocked field goal turned touchdown, getting the team back on the board and swinging momentum their way. But it wasn’t enough, as the offense still continued to have its struggles despite some success, and the defense struggled to stop Bijan Robinson all night. It’s a tough loss, but they will look to rebound next week and into the NFL playoffs.

news.body: The Vikings D/ST allowed 16 points on 243 total yards with six sacks and two interceptions on Sunday against the Bucs.
news.head: Vikings D/ST dominates in win Sunday
news.impact: The Vikings D/ST also scored a touchdown on a punt return. Minnesota needed its defense to come through as the offense struggled for most of the afternoon. They will be a top play next week against the Dolphins.

news.body: The Vikings D/ST registered four sacks while also forcing two turnovers (one interception, one fumble recovery) in a 9-3 win over the Chicago Bears in Week 2.
news.head: Vikings D/ST disruptive in Week 2
news.impact: The unit was able to stand tall against a Chicago ground attack, holding both D’Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai to less than 50 yards rushing each. The defense will look to take advantage of a turnover-prone Tampa Bay Buccaneers offense in Week 3.

news.body: The Vikings D/ST allowed 22 points on 419 total yards with one interception, one fumble recovery and four sacks on Sunday against the Packers.
news.head: Vikings D/ST picks it up late Sunday
news.impact: Minnesota struggled in the first half defensively, but limited Green Bay to just three points in the second half where they out-scored the Packers 29-3. They'll be tough to trust next week against the Bears.

news.body: The Minnesota Vikings D/ST allowed only 121 yards of total offense and sacked Green Bay quarterback Clayton Tune four times en route to a 16-3 win over the Packers on Sunday.
news.head: Minnesota Vikings D/ST shuts down Packers in Week 18
news.impact: Green Bay rested most of its starters on Sunday as it entered the game locked into the #7 seed in the NFC. However, take nothing away from the Vikings, who allowed -7 net passing yards on the afternoon. Minnesota finished with four sacks - two by Dallas Turner - and also had eight tackles for a loss.

news.body: The Giants' D/ST logged one sack, one interception, and one fumble recovery while allowing 28 points in Monday night's loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Giants D/ST allows 28 points in loss Monday
news.impact: New York's defense struggled on Monday night. They allowed 28 points over the course of the game, despite actually forcing a couple turnovers to help their offense out. This unit should not be started moving forward, even with a relatively easy schedule coming down the pipe for them.

news.body: The Giants' D/ST logged one interception and allowed 20 points in Sunday night's win over the Dallas Cowboys.
news.head: Giants D/ST allows 20 points Sunday
news.impact: New York's defense helped lead the team to a win on Sunday night. They held Dallas' talented offense to just 20 points over the course of the night and logged takeaway to help out the offense. They were held without a sack all game, however, so their pass rush will likely need to improve if they want to continue winning games moving forward.

news.body: The New York Giants are finalizing a deal to sign John Harbaugh as their next head coach.
news.head: New York Giants finalizing deal with John Harbaugh
news.impact: Harbaugh was the Ravens' long-time head coach and found plenty of success in Baltimore. As the man in charge, he had a record of 180-113 and won a Super Bowl. He would team up with quarterback Jaxson Dart to bring the Giants back to the postseason, though the deal is not yet finalized.

news.body: The Giants defense allowed just 17 points on 286 yards of offense, forcing two turnovers in Sunday's win over the Cowboys.
news.head: Giants defense plays well in season finale
news.impact: Certainly benefiting from the Cowboys' main offensive contributors playing limited snaps Sunday, the Giants defense mostly controlled the Cowboys offense in Sunday's victory. The Giants defense has ranked among the bottom third of the league in yards and points allowed most of the season, so the team will certainly be looking to build on that side of the ball this offseason.

news.body: The Eagles D/ST allowed 20 points while adding two sacks in a 24-20 win over the Titans in Week 2.
news.head: Eagles D/ST picks up two sacks in Week 2
news.impact: Philadelphia held Tennessee to 291 yards of total offense but they needed a last-minute TD pass from Jalen Hurts to avoid the upset. The Eagles will now head on the road to take on a Bears offense that could be without Caleb Williams (hamstring) in Week 3.

news.body: The Eagles D/ST registered one sack while failing to force any turnovers in a 24-22 win over the Washington Commanders in Week 1.
news.head: Eagles D/ST registers one sack in Week 1
news.impact: The unit left plenty to be desired in the season-opening win, allowing 296 offensive yards and three touchdowns on the day. The defense will look for more disruptive results for fantasy managers against an underwhelming Tennessee Titans offense in Week 2.

news.body: The Eagles D/ST allowed 24 points while forcing two turnovers in a 24-17 loss to the Commanders in Week 18.
news.head: Eagles D/ST forces two turnovers in Week 18
news.impact: Philadelphia's defense struggled to contain Washington's offense in the loss, although they did manage one interception and recovered one fumble. They will now prepare to face the 49ers at home in the Wild-Card round next week.

news.body: The Philadelphia Eagles D/ST used a dominant first-half performance to hang on for a 13-12 road victory over the Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
news.head: Philadelphia Eagles D/ST comes up clutch against Bills Sunday
news.impact: The Bills had a chance to win at the end of the game but a failed two-point conversion allowed the Eagles to escape with the one-point victory. Philadelphia had five sacks of Josh Allen on the day, at least two of which knocked the Bills out of field goal range. One of the sacks was a fumble recovery that led to an Eagles touchdown. Philadelphia closes out the regular season on Sunday at home against Washington.

news.body: The Steelers D/ST allowed 27 points, 282 passing yards, and 83 rushing yards in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
news.head: Steelers D/ST allows 27 points in Week 3 win
news.impact: The Steelers' defense tallied one sack and one fumble recovery in the win Sunday. The fumble recovery came on the final drive for the Bengals to help seal the win for the Steelers. The defense will now prepare for the Browns in Week 4.

news.body: The Steelers D/ST allowed 14 points, 208 passing yards, and 136 rushing yards in the 20-3 loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Steelers D/ST allows 14 points in Week 2 loss
news.impact: The Steelers' defense did tally an interception, a fumble recovery, and three sacks in the losing effort Sunday. The Steelers' defense will be at home against a strong Bengals' offense in Week 3.

news.body: The Steelers D/ST allowed 13 points while scoring a touchdown, forcing two turnovers, and notching four sacks in a 20-13 win over the Falcons in Week 1.
news.head: Steelers D/ST scores TD in Week 1 win
news.impact: Pittsburgh took advantage of the Falcons being forced to start their third-string QB in Cooper Rush. T.J. Watt dominated the whole afternoon as he sealed the game with a 35-yard pick-six in the fourth quarter while also logging two sacks. The Steelers will have a tougher test in Week 2 against the Patriots.

news.body: The Pittsburgh Steelers are working on a deal to sign Mike McCarthy as the organization's next head coach.
news.head: Steelers hiring Mike McCarthy as head coach
news.impact: McCarthy will succeed Mike Tomlin as the head man for the Steelers. Like Tomlin, McCarthy is one of the winningest coaches in NFL history, with a career record of 60.8% and 174 wins (15th). The Steelers value stability, and McCarthy brings that, along with ties to the city.

news.body: The Seattle Seahawks D/ST shut down the Arizona Cardinals offense on Sunday 31-7, racking up an interception and two sacks in the big win.
news.head: Seattle Seahawks D/ST shuts down Cardinals defense on Sunday
news.impact: Seattle's defense has allowed a grand total of 17 points over two weeks. They're shaping up to be a formidable unit so far, and are a top defense to roster for fantasy moving forward.

news.body: The Seahawks' D/ST logged three sacks and three interceptions while allowing just ten points in Wednesday night's win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Seahawks D/ST stellar in win Wednesday
news.impact: Seattle's defense put up a fantastic showing on Wednesday night. They not only held New England's strong offense to just ten points on the night, but they also recorded three interceptions, including one on the final drive of the game to seal the win. This unit is expected to be elite over the course of the season, assuming all of their key players remain healthy and on the field.

news.body: The Seattle Seahawks D/ST held the high-powered 49ers offense to just 173 total yards on Saturday night as Seattle clinched the NFC West and the top seed in the NFC with a 13-3 victory.
news.head: Seattle Seahawks D/ST shuts down 49ers offense Saturday
news.impact: The Seahawks' defense was swarming all night, limiting the 49ers to just nine first downs and 173 total yards for the game. Seattle sacked Brock Purdy three times and also got a huge interception from Drake Thomas at the Seahawks' three-yard line early in the fourth quarter. San Francisco was 2-of-9 on third downs and averaged only 4.1 yards per play on the night.

news.body: The Seahawks D/ST allowed 10 points on 139 total yards with two sacks, one interception and one fumble recovery on Sunday.
news.head: Seahawks D/ST dominates Panthers passing attack Sunday
news.impact: The Seahawks held Tetairoa McMillan to just one catch all game. They allowed one touchdown with the field goal coming on short yardage following a Sam Darnold fumble. They draw a 49ers offense on fire in Week 18 with the division and No. 1 seed on the line.

news.body: The 49ers D/ST allowed 30 points on 365 total yards with two sacks on Sunday against the Cardinals.
news.head: 49ers D/ST struggles late Sunday
news.impact: San Francisco allowed just six points in the first half before allowing 24 points in the second half. They'll face Bo Nix and the Broncos next week.

news.body: The 49ers' defense allowed just 13 points on 284 yards of offense while recording four sacks in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: 49ers D/ST records four sacks, stifles Dolphins offense
news.impact: For the second straight week, the 49ers' defense dominated. The unit has surrendered just 20 points in two games, holding both the Rams and Dolphins under 300 yards of total offense. The 49ers will remain a popular play in Week 3 against the Cardinals.

news.body: The San Fransisco 49ers D/ST shut down the Rams offense on Thursday, allowing just seven points in their 27-7 rout of the Super Bowl favorites.
news.head: San Fransisco 49ers D/ST shuts down Rams in win
news.impact: The Niners defensive totals were modest, with one interception and a fumble recovery, but were held without a sack. They just kept the Rams from moving the ball while not racking up much in the “counting stats” category. It’s a good showing for the team, and a date with the Dolphins is on tap. They are a great DST option this week if available.

news.body: The San Francisco 49ers D/ST could muster only two sacks and did not force a turnover during their 13-3 loss to Seattle on Saturday night.
news.head: San Francisco 49ers D/ST does nothing of note Saturday
news.impact: Yes, the 49ers only gave up 13 points. But, it could have been much worse as Jason Myers missed two field goals and the Seahawks failed to convert on fourth-and-goal on the game's first drive. Seattle had 361 net yards, including 180 on the ground, and did not turn the ball over against the 49ers defense. That's two straight weeks - and three of the last four - that San Francisco has not forced a turnover.

news.body: Patriots K Andy Borregales connected on 2-of-3 field goals and 2-of-2 extra points in the Patriots' 20-3 win over the Steelers.
news.head: Andy Borregales connects on two field goals in Week 2 win
news.impact: Borregales connected on field goal attempts from 30 and 45 yards out, while missing from 47-yards out. The second-year kicker should continue to see plenty of field goal opportunities until the passing attack can find consistency.

news.body: Andy Borregales made his lone field-goal attempt and his lone extra-point attempt in Wednesday night's 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Andy Borregales scores four points Wednesday
news.impact: The young kicker didn't get many opportunities on Wednesday night. He converted both of his attempts, however, leaving him with at least four points on the night. He doesn't project to be a strong option at the position moving forward.

news.body: Andy Borregales went 5-for-5 on his extra-point attempts and went 1-for-2 on his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 38-10 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Andy Borregales misses one kick Sunday
news.impact: Borregales had an up-and-down game on Sunday. He missed one of his field-goal attempts against the Dolphins, but outside of that he made all of his kicks, including a field goal from 59 yards out. He has proven himself to be reliable overall and should remain their starter in 2026.

news.body: Andy Borregales went 0-for-1 on field goal attempts and 6-for-6 on extra points in the Patriots 42-10 win over the Jets.
news.head: Andy Borregales misses lone field goal attempt
news.impact: Borregales missed a 41-yard attempt late in the third quarter, his first missed field goal since Week 13. The rookie has been fairly consistent this season and will look to build upon a strong rookie campaign in Week 18.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey connected on all three field goal attempts and all four of his extra point attempts in a win over the Commanders.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey perfect in Week 2 win
news.impact: Aubrey connected on field goals from 25, 44, and 60 yards out to help pace the Cowboys to their first win over the season. Aubrey remains one of the best kickers in the league and is a strong start against Baltimore in Week 3.

news.body: Brandon Aubrey went 2-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday night's 28-20 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey misses one kick Sunday
news.impact: Aubrey didn't have a good night on Sunday night. He scored just two points in the team's loss to New York, and he even missed one of his extra-point attempts late in the game. He should bounce back and return to being a good fantasy option sometime in the near future.

news.body: The Cowboys signed K Brandon Aubrey to a four-year, $28 million contract extension.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey signs four-year extension with Cowboys
news.impact: Aubrey becomes the first kicker to ever earn $7 million per year and receive $20 million guaranteed. He has established himself as the top kicker in the NFL.

news.body: Cowboys restricted free agent kicker Brandon Aubrey has until Friday to sign an offer sheet with another team.
news.head: Brandon Aubrey has until Friday to sign offer sheet with another team
news.impact: If Aubrey does not sign an offer sheet with another team by Friday, Dallas retains his rights for the 2026 season. He appears likely to remain with the Cowboys.

news.body: Cam Little made two of his three field goals and added an extra point in a 20-13 loss to the Broncos in Week 2.
news.head: Cam Little makes two FGs in Week 2
news.impact: Little hit field goals from 44 and 23 yards out in the game. The veteran kicker has hit four of his five field goals while going a perfect 5-for-5 on extra points through two games. He will take on the Patriots in Week 3.

news.body: Cam Little made both of his field goal attempts and all four of his PATs in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns on Sunday.
news.head: Cam Little has nice day against Browns
news.impact: Little should be a nice kicker for those in need of one, or for those who have him, thanks to the firepower the Jags offense possesses. He will look to keep up his success next week against Denver.

news.body: Cam Little made all five of his PATs and both of his field goal attempts in the Jaguars' 41-7 win over the Titans.
news.head: Cam Little racks up 11 kicking points in win
news.impact: Little had a great game with the Jaguars putting up a scoring onslaught against the Titans. He's now put up 10+ kicking points in each of his last five games.

news.body: Cam Little connected on 3-of-3 field goal attempts and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Cam Little makes all five kicks Sunday
news.impact: Little has connected on 28-of-32 field goals overall. He should be in line for plenty of opportunities in Week 18 against the Titans.

news.body: Cameron Dicker converted 3-of-4 field goal attempts while also making his lone extra point attempt to finish with 10 points in the Chargers' 24-16 loss to the Buffalo Bills in Week 3.
news.head: Cameron Dicker misses field goal in Week 3
news.impact: Dicker made the most of increased opportunities for head coach Jim Harbaugh, finishing with more than two points for the first time in three contests. The kicker has fallen victim to kicking behind an underwhelming Chargers offense to begin the season, with a Week 4 contest against the Seattle Seahawks up next.

news.body: Cameron Dicker went 2-for-2 on his extra-point attempts but missed his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Cameron Dicker misses kick in loss Sunday
news.impact: The Chargers didn't have much going for them on Sunday, including kicking. Dicker misses his lone field-goal against the Raiders, leaving three more points on the field for Los Angeles. Fantasy managers of the 26-year old should consider moving to a different fantasy option for the time being.

news.body: Cameron Dicker did not attempt a field goal and made 2-of-2 PATs in Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Cardinals.
news.head: Cameron Dicker puts just two points on the board in Week 1
news.impact: Widely viewed as one of the best fantasy options among kickers, Dicker was not given much of an opportunity to contribute on Sunday. The Chargers drastically underperformed expectations, totaling only 268 yards of offense and being dominated in time of possession. Dicker will have better games, but this one was a huge disappointment for fantasy managers.

news.body: Cameron Dicker made his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 19-3 loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Cameron Dicker makes lone kick Sunday
news.impact: Dicker was only given one opportunity on Sunday, but he was able to make it and finished with three points in the team's loss to the Broncos. That capped off what was another fantastic season for him, finishing as a top-four kicker in most fantasy league formats and distinguishing himself as one of the league's most consistent kickers in real life.

news.body: Eddy Pineiro made his lone field goal and 3-of-5 extra points on Sunday.
news.head: Eddy Pineiro misses two extra points Sunday
news.impact: Pineiro made his lone field goal from 57 yards out. It was a rare off day for him kicking extra points.

news.body: Eddy Pineiro did not attempt a field goal but made all five of his PATs in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Eddy Pineiro makes five PATs in Sunday's win
news.impact: The 49ers found the end zone with each of their first five drives Sunday afternoon, and did not give Pineiro any field-goal chances. That's obviously not going to be the case each week. The veteran should be a solid fantasy option for a squad that looks really strong so far.

news.body: Eddy Pineiro (illness) will kick for the 49ers in Week 2's matchup with the Dolphins.
news.head: Eddy Pineiro (illness) ready to go for Sunday's game
news.impact: Pineiro has missed practice all week due to being under the weather, but the veteran kicker will be ready to go Sunday. Pineiro hit 2-of-3 field goals and all three of his PATs in Week 1.

news.body: Eddy Pineiro (illness) is uncertain to play in Sunday's game against the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Eddy Pineiro (illness) uncertain to play Sunday
news.impact: The veteran kicker is officially considered questionable to play heading into the weekend. He is dealing with a mildly serious illness right now that has left him sidelined from practice all week, and it's unclear whether or not he will be ready to go in time for the team's matchup against the Dolphins, which would make them need to determine who will take his place prior to kickoff.

news.body: Evan McPherson connected on 2-of-2 field goal attempts and all three extra point attempts in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers.
news.head: Evan McPherson perfect in Week 3
news.impact: McPherson continues to provide the Bengals with a steady leg on special teams, as he has yet to miss a kick so far this season. The 27-year-old will look to continue his strong start to the season against the Jaguars in Week 4.

news.body: Evan McPherson made both field goal and extra point attempts on Sunday against the Texans.
news.head: Evan McPherson connects on four kicks Sunday
news.impact: McPherson connected on field goals from 51 and 57 yards out. He remains fairly safe for fantasy managers week-to-week.

news.body: Evan McPherson made 4-of-4 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Evan McPherson connects on seven kicks Sunday
news.impact: McPherson connected on field goals from 20, 55, 58 and 32 yards out. He should remain a fairly reliable weekly play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Evan McPherson failed to hit either of his PATs in the Bengals' 20-18 loss to the Browns on Sunday.
news.head: Evan McPherson shut out in loss
news.impact: McPherson's failed PATs put the Bengals on the backfoot, forcing them to take a 2-PT conversion attempt that ultimately failed. He's been solid and actually finished with the best FGM % of his career. He should be a good bet for fantasy relevance next season.

news.body: Harrison Butker converted all three of his extra point attempts while missing 1-of-2 field goal attempts to finish with six points in the Chiefs' 24-10 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 3.
news.head: Harrison Butker misses field goal in Week 3
news.impact: Butker continues a solid start to the season, recording six or more points in each of the first three contests. The kicker remains one of the more stable options in all formats behind a revamped Kansas City offense for head coach Andy Reid, with a Week 4 contest against the Las Vegas Raiders up next.

news.body: Harrison Butker went 4-for-5 on his field-goal attempts and 3-for-3 on his extra-point attempts in Sunday night's 33-30 overtime win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Harrison Butker scores 15 points in OT win Sunday
news.impact: Butker missed one field goal on Sunday night, but outside of that, he was perfect. He made all seven of his other kicks, including a walk-off kick which secured the win for Kansas City in overtime. He should continue to be a good fantasy asset moving forward.

news.body: Harrison Butker went 4-for-4 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Monday night's 31-10 win over the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Harrison Butker perfect in win Monday
news.impact: Butker did his job on Monday night, hitting all five of his kicks in the team's big win over the Broncos. He didn't end up with a good total from a fantasy perspective, but he should still be considered one of the better fantasy options at his position moving forward.

news.body: Harrison Butker connected on 4-of-4 field goals in the Chiefs 14-12 loss to the Raiders.
news.head: Harrison Butker perfect in Week 18 loss
news.impact: Butker connected on field goals from 36, 40, 41, and 47 to account for all of the scoring for the Chiefs Sunday. The veteran kicker remains under contract with the Chiefs for 2026 and should remain one of the top options at the position for fantasy managers.

news.body: Harrison Mevis went 4-for-4 on his extra-point attempts but missed his lone field-goal attempt in Monday night's 28-6 win over the New York Giants.
news.head: Harrison Mevis misses kick in win Monday
news.impact: Mevis missed a field goal late in Monday night's game, but luckily for him, it wasn't very consequential with Los Angeles already being up several scores. He should return to being a solid fantasy option at the position somewhat soon.

news.body: Harrison Mevis made his only PAT attempt in the Rams' 27-7 tough loss to the 49ers.
news.head: Harrison Mevis kicks single PAT in loss to Niners
news.impact: Mevis wasn't called upon much, the Rams offense was just never in scoring position for most of the game. He could have come in in the second half, but the Rams elected to go for it on 4th and goal at the 1 yard line, which was the correct choice, but their failure to convert meant Mevis was going to have an even bigger stinker. Brighter days are ahead for the Rams kicker.

news.body: Harrison Mevis has been tendered by the Rams and will return to Los Angeles for the 2026 season.
news.head: Harrison Mevis returns to Rams after being tendered Monday
news.impact: Undrafted out of Missouri in 2024, Mevis was a revelation for both the Rams and for fantasy owners last season. He replaced Joshua Karty as Los Angeles' kicker midway through they year and went 12-for-13 on field goal tries and a perfect 39-of-39 on extra point attempts in nine regular season games. He was also perfect in three postseason contests, going 6-for-6 on field goals and 9-for-9 on PATs. Mevis will open 2026 as the Rams' primary kicker and, given the potency of Los Angeles' offense, should be in line for a big year.

news.body: Harrison Mevis connected on 3-of-3 field goals and 4-of-4 extra points in the Rams 37-20 win over the Cardinals.
news.head: Harrison Mevis perfect in Week 18
news.impact: Mevis connected on field goals from 34, 40, and 42 yards out in the win. Mevis will end his first season with the Rams 12-of-13 on field goal attempts and 39-of-39 on extra point attempts.

news.body: Jake Bates connected on his lone field goal attempt and all four of his extra point attempts in a 31-24 win over the Jets.
news.head: Jake Bates perfect in Week 3 win
news.impact: Bates was perfect after each touchdown and made his lone field goal from 30-yards out to open the scoring in the second quarter. Bates has yet to miss a kick this season and will take his perfect season on the road to Carolina in Week 4.

news.body: Jake Bates went 4-for-4 on his extra-point attempts and made his lone field-goal attempt in Thursday night's 41-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Jake Bates perfect in loss Thursday
news.impact: Bates did his job on Thursday night. He made all five of his kicks over the course of the game, so he carries no blame for Detroit's loss to the Bills. He should continue to be a quality fantasy asset at the position moving forward.

news.body: Jake Bates converted all four of his extra point attempts as well as his lone field goal attempt to finish with seven points in the Lions' 31-30 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 1.
news.head: Jake Bates picks up seven points in Week 1
news.impact: Bates made the most of his opportunities behind a Detroit offense that battled consistency issues in the season opener. The kicker should once again be in line for plenty of opportunities in what should be a high-scoring Week 2 matchup against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: The Lions tendered exclusive rights free agent K Jake Bates.
news.head: Jake Bates tendered by Lions
news.impact: Bates took a slight step back last season, but he has still been a stable kicker for the Lions. He'll remain a strong option for fantasy managers next season.

news.body: Jason Myers converted his only field goal attempt as well as all four of his extra point attempts to finish with seven points in the Seahawks' 33-31 loss to the Washington Commanders in Week 3.
news.head: Jason Myers racks up seven points in Week 3
news.impact: Myers continues a strong start to the season, recording seven points in each of the first three contests. The kicker remains one of the more impactful options in related formats, with a Week 4 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers up next.

news.body: Jason Myers hit all four of his PATs and his lone field goal attempt in the Seahawks' 31-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.head: Jason Myers hits four PATs in win over Arizona
news.impact: Myers has had seven kicking points in each of his first two games, a solid total. He's going to continue to be productive thanks to the Seahawks offense being as potent as it is.

news.body: Jason Myers went 2-for-2 on his field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point attempt in Wednesday's 13-10 win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Jason Myers scores seven points in win Wednesday
news.impact: Myers did his job on Wednesday, knocking in all three of his kicks en route to a win over the Patriots. He will likely be a decent fantasy option at the position over the course of the season, assuming QB Sam Darnold (hip) doesn't miss significant time and leave the offense weaker moving forward.

news.body: Jason Myers missed two field goal attempts on Saturday night but the Seahawks still managed a 13-3 win over San Francisco to clinch the top seed in the NFC.
news.head: Jason Myers has rare off night Saturday
news.impact: Myers had made 18 straight field goal attempts before his miss from 47 yards out early in the second quarter. He also missed on Seattle's last drive of the game when he hit the right upright from 26 yards away. Myers did have makes of 45 yards and 31 yards and also converted his only extra point attempt. Myers finishes with career highs in field goals made (41) and field goal attempts (48) while also converting a perfect 48-of-48 on PATs.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn connected on his lone field goal attempts and two extra point attempts in a 19-17 loss to the Colts.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn perfect in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Fairbairn made his lone field goal attempt for 24-yard outs in the fourth quarter. The 32-year-old has missed just one kick so far in the first three games. Houston will take on Dallas in Week 4.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn connected on 2-of-3 field goal attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn makes two field goals Sunday
news.impact: Fairbairn connected on field goals from 37 and 45 yards out. He missed from 58 yards out in the third quarter.

news.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn made his only field-goal try and all four of his PATs in Sunday's 36-31 loss to the Bills.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn puts seven points on the board
news.impact: Fairbairn showed off his powerful leg in Sunday's loss, nailing a 58-yard attempt to briefly give the Texans a one-point lead in the fourth quarter. The veteran has been kicking for the Texans since 2017 and remains one of the more reliable options in the league.

news.body: The Texans re-signed K Ka'imi Fairbairn to a two-year, $13 million deal.
news.head: Ka'imi Fairbairn re-signs with Texans
news.impact: Fairbairn will remain in Houston for two more years. He remains one of the top kickers in the NFL and for fantasy managers.

news.body: Trey Smack hit both of his PATs in the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons.
news.head: Trey Smack quiet in loss to Falcons
news.impact: Smack hit both of his chances, but the Packers either couldn't get into field goal range, or decided to go for it on fourth down when they did. Better days will come for the kicker, and the Green Bay offense can still put up points on any given week. Their run game is stifling them at the moment, so if they figure that out, the points will come.

news.body: Trey Smack converted each of his two field goal attempts as well as both of his extra point attempts to finish with eight points in the Packers’ 20-17 win over the New York Jets in Week 2.
news.head: Trey Smack picks up eight points in Week 2
news.impact: Smack continues a strong start to the season, racking up eight or more points in each of the first two games. The kicker will look for more success in a favorable Week 3 contest against the Atlanta Falcons.

news.body: Trey Smack went 3-for-3 on field goal attempts and 1-for-2 on extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.head: Trey Smack nails two deep field goals Sunday
news.impact: Smack nailed field goals from 59, 43 and 26 yards out. The Packers have found a kicker they can rely on.

news.body: Tyler Loop made 1-of-2 field goals and 2-of-2 extra point attempts in the Ravens loss to the Saints.
news.head: Tyler Loop makes one field goal in Week 2 loss
news.impact: Loop had a 49-yard field goal blocked in the first half, but made a 49-yard field goal in the second half. The Ravens take on the Cowboys in Week 3, which should provide Loop with plenty of chances in what should be a high scoring matchup.

news.body: Tyler Loop converted both of his field goal attempts as well as all five of his extra point attempts to finish with 11 points in a 41-23 Week 1 win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Tyler Loop racks up 11 points in Week 1 win
news.impact: Loop capitalized on every opportunity for head coach Jesse Minter, finishing with a perfect stat line in the Week 1 win. The kicker will look to take advantage of another favorable matchup in Week 2 against the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Tyler Loop made one of his two field goals and all three of his extra points in a 26-24 loss to the Steelers in Week 18.
news.head: Tyler Loop misses potential game-winning FG in Week 18
news.impact: Loop hit a 40-yard field goal but he missed a potential game-winning 44-yard attempt with two seconds left in the fourth quarter. It was a costly miss as the Ravens' loss gave the Steelers the AFC North title and caused Baltimore to miss the playoffs. Overall, it was a strong rookie season for Loop, who hit 30 of his 34 attempts and missed just two of his 46 extra points.

news.body: Tyler Loop made all five of his PATs and both of his FG attempts in the Ravens' 41-24 win over the Packers.
news.head: Tyler Loop busy in win over Green Bay
news.impact: Loop had 11 kicking points in this game, as many as he had in his previous two games combined. He should be a decent play next week for fantasy for those who need him.

news.body: Brock Purdy completed 15-of-27 passes for 297 yards and four touchdowns in the 49ers 36-30 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
news.head: Brock Purdy tosses four touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Purdy also had a rushing score late that was called back on a penalty by George Kittle. His first passing touchdown was a completion to Mike Evans, who lateraled the ball to Deebo Samuel for the long score. He draws a tougher matchup against the Broncos next week.

news.body: Brock Purdy connected on 20-of-22 passes for 287 yards and two touchdowns, adding 30 yards and a touchdown on three carries in Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins.
news.head: Brock Purdy turns in tremendous effort against Dolphins
news.impact: Purdy is off to an outstanding start this season, and he could hardly have been more prolific in Sunday's rout of the Dolphins. The fifth-year QB has completed a ridiculous 80.4% of his passes so far, averaging 246 yards with a 5-1 TD/INT ratio through two games. Purdy has also rushed for 59 yards on eight carries, including a two-yard scoring scramble on Sunday. He'll be a QB to start against the Cardinals in Week 3.

news.body: Brock Purdy completed 25-of-34 passes for 205 yards, three touchdowns, and a pick in the 49ers' 27-7 win over the Rams on Thursday. He also ran five times for 29 yards.
news.head: Brock Purdy dismantles Rams defense in statement win
news.impact: Purdy was great in this game aside from a couple of hiccups, namely the interception. However, he did what he needed to and got the Niners into scoring position and helped them take advantage of the several short fields they inherited. Purdy should be a solid asset moving forward for fantasy.

news.body: Brock Purdy completed 19-of-27 passes for just 127 yards and one interception in the 49ers 13-3 loss to the Seahawks.
news.head: Brock Purdy shut down by Seattle defense Saturday
news.impact: Purdy was held to a season-low 127 yards and failed to reach 200 yards through the air in a game for just the third time in his nine starts. It was also his only start of the year without throwing a touchdown pass. He carried the ball twice for 21 yards and had San Francisco's longest run of the night (11 yards).

news.body: Caleb Williams has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Eagles.
news.head: Caleb Williams (hamstring) ruled out Monday
news.impact: Williams was never expected to play this week after going down with his injury last week. It will be Tyson Bagent or Case Keenum starting on Monday.

news.body: Caleb Williams (hamstring) was again a non-participant at practice on Friday.
news.head: Caleb Williams (hamstring) a non-participant Friday
news.impact: The Bears have all but officially ruled out Williams for Monday's game, so it's not surprising to see him sit out for another practice session on Friday. He's currently considered week-to-week, and it looks like the Bears might have to start Case Keenum this week with Tyson Bagent (concussion) also trending towards being sidelined.

news.body: Caleb Williams (hamstring) officially did not take part in Chicago's practice on Thursday.
news.head: Caleb Williams (hamstring) officially doesn't practice Thursday
news.impact: Williams suffered a mildly serious hamstring injury last week and is expected to miss at least a game or two while he recovers. He wasn't able to practice on Thursday, which further solidifies that he is not going to make a surprise return and be ready to go in time for Monday night's game. It looks like Chicago may have to start Case Keenum this week with Tyson Bagent (concussion) also trending toward being sidelined against the Eagles, which would render most of Chicago's fantasy options unstartable for that matchup.

news.body: Caleb Williams (hamstring) is "week-to-week", per HC Ben Johnson. Initial optimism about his status has given way to reality, and it now seems likely Williams will miss time.
news.head: Caleb Williams (hamstring) labeled week-to-week with hamstring injury
news.impact: It's a bummer for Williams, who looked to be on his way to a great start to the year. Tyson Bagent is the next man up in Chicago, and he's shown promise in previous outings when taking over for Williams.

news.body: Dak Prescott completed 26-of-31 passes for 279 yards and four touchdowns in the win over the Commanders. He added 26 rushing yards on four carries.
news.head: Dak Prescott tosses four touchdowns in Week 2 win
news.impact: Prescott found CeeDee Lamb for two of his four touchdowns and Jake Ferguson for the other two in a key win over a divisional rival. Prescott and the Cowboys will look to build on this strong performance as they take on the Ravens in Week 3.

news.body: Dak Prescott completed 22-of-34 passing attempts for 175 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception in Sunday night's 28-20 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Dak Prescott underwhelming in loss Sunday
news.impact: Prescott didn't deliver a great performance on Sunday night. He was held to under 200 passing yards against the Giants and lost one turnover in Dallas' loss to their divisional rival. He will have a good opportunity to bounce back next week against the Commanders, but this is not the type of performance fantasy managers wanted to see out of him in the season opener.

news.body: Cowboys head coach Brian Schottenheimer said he won’t play starters in the preseason.
news.head: Dak Prescott, Cowboys starters will not play in preseason
news.impact: Schottenheimer said he broke up all players into four groups for preseason playing time. The A group plays zero snaps, B+ group plays 10-15 snaps, B- group plays 20-25 snaps and the C group plays unlimited snaps. We'll get our first look at Dak Prescott and the Cowboys starters in Week 1 against the Giants.

news.body: Dak Prescott was limited in practice during minicamp on Tuesday.
news.head: Dak Prescott (knee) limited in practice Tuesday
news.impact: Prescott took four reps in team drills when he would normally would’ve had eight. It does not appear to be anything serious that he is dealing with after he was expected to be limited.

news.body: Patriots QB Drake Maye completed 14-of-22 pass attempts for 208 yards and one interception in the Patriots' 20-3 win over the Steelers. He added 17 rushing yards on four carries.
news.head: Drake Maye tosses fourth INT of the season in winning effort
news.impact: Maye completed passes to nine different pass catchers in the Patriots' first win of the season. The interceptions continue to plague the young quarterback, as he now has four on the season. Maye and the Patriots will take on the Jaguars in Jacksonville in Week 3.

news.body: Drake Maye completed 23-of-33 passing attempts for 178 yards, one touchdown, and three interceptions while adding 47 yards on the ground in Wednesday night's 13-10 loss to the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Drake Maye throws three interceptions in loss Wednesday
news.impact: Maye started the season on the wrong foot on Wednesday night. He threw for under 200 yards and three interceptions against a tough Seattle defense, including one that cost the Patriots the game. He still showed lots of ability on the ground, however, and he's likely to return to being a good fantasy option against easier defenses. The loss of A.J. Brown (ankle) for at least a few games will severely hamper his short-term upside, however.

news.body: Drake Maye is not on the injury report for the Super Bowl against the Seahawks.
news.head: Drake Maye (shoulder) off injury report for Super Bowl
news.impact: Maye was able to practice fully all week. He is officially good to go for the biggest game of the season on Sunday.

news.body: Drake Maye was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Drake Maye (shoulder) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: Maye has logged two straight full practices to begin the week. He remains on track to be a full-go on Sunday in the Super Bowl.

news.body: Jalen Hurts completed 26 of his 37 passes for 264 yards, two touchdowns, and two interceptions while adding five rushes for 16 yards in a 24-20 win over the Titans in Week 2.
news.head: Jalen Hurts throws two TDs in Week 2
news.impact: Hurts saved the day for the Eagles, throwing a three-yard touchdown to Darius Cooper with 14 seconds left in regulation. The veteran quarterback also made some mistakes, tossing two interceptions and taking three sacks. Hurts now has five touchdown passes through two games, but he has yet to score any rushing TDs. He will be a high-end QB1 in Week 3 against the Bears on the road.

news.body: Jalen Hurts completed 14-of-25 pass attempts for 203 yards and three touchdowns while also rushing seven times for 46 yards in the Eagles’ 24-22 Week 1 win over the Washington Commanders.
news.head: Jalen Hurts tosses three touchdowns in Week 1 win over Commanders
news.impact: Hurts made the most of an inconsistent season-opening performance behind center, averaging 14.5 yards per completion in the win. The quarterback will look to reward fantasy managers with more explosive dual-threat production in a favorable Week 2 matchup against the Tennessee Titans.

news.body: The Eagles are expected to rest QB Jalen Hurts in Week 18 against the Commanders
news.head: Jalen Hurts expected to sit out season finale
news.impact: Philadelphia is expected to rest most of its starters in the season finale. Third-year QB Tanner McKee will get the start against a struggling Washington defense and could be a serviceable DFS option. Jalen Hurts will turn his focus to the postseason, while also looking ahead to 2026 as a high-end fantasy QB1.

news.body: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni said “we’re still thinking through” whether the team would play their starters in Week 18.
news.head: Jalen Hurts: Eagles starters uncertain for Week 18
news.impact: The Eagles still have a chance to move up to the No. 2 seed in the NFC in the playoffs. There should be more clarity by Wednesday or Thursday on who will be starting for the Eagles.

news.body: Jared Goff completed 25-of-32 passes for 269 yards and two touchdowns in a 31-24 win over the Jets. He also rushed for six yards on four carries.
news.head: Jared Goff tosses two touchdowns in Week 3
news.impact: Goff found Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs through the air to help pace the Lions to a home win over the Jets. Goff has yet to throw an interception this year and has three straight multi-touchdown games to open the season. The Lions will take on the Panthers on the road in Week 4.

news.body: Jared Goff completed 26-of-38 passing attempts for 327 yards and four touchdowns in Thursday night's 41-31 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Jared Goff throws four touchdowns in win Thursday
news.impact: Goff and Detroit's offense struggled at the start of the game on Thursday night, but they were able to get things going later, and he ended up throwing four touchdowns in a shootout loss to the Buffalo Bills. He has looked terrific to start the season and should continue to be a safe week-to-week streaming option for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Jared Goff completed 26-of-39 pass attempts for 206 yards and two touchdowns while also rushing twice for two yards in the Lions' 31-30 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 1.
news.head: Jared Goff tosses two touchdowns in Week 1 win over Saints
news.impact: Goff took what the New Orleans defense allowed, relying on dynamic running back Jahmyr Gibbs to carry a rusty Detroit starting offense in the Week 1 win. The veteran signal-caller remains a stable mid-tier option with QB1 upside ahead of a Week 2 matchup against the Buffalo Bills.

news.body: Jared Goff will not play in the Lions second preseason game on Saturday against the Commanders.
news.head: Jared Goff will not play Saturday
news.impact: Goff could see some reps in the final preseason game. It will be Josh Dobbs starting with Luke Altmyer seeing reps behind him.

news.body: Jaxson Dart (knee) will undergo season-ending surgery.
news.head: Jaxson Dart (knee) to miss the rest of the season
news.impact: Dart had been getting multiple opinions on his ACL injury. Examination shows that the ligament is intact, but Dart will still require surgery that will end his second-season. Jameis Winston will take over as QB1 for the Giants.

news.body: Jaxson Dart (knee) has undergone further testing on his injured knee and they have revealed it could be a season-ending injury. What looked like a promising 2026 is quickly turning upside down for the Giants.
news.head: Jaxson Dart (knee) testing reveals knee injury could be season-ending
news.impact: Dart went down early in the first quarter with a knee injury, and did not return despite pushing to come back into the game. Now with testing revealing that his injuries could be season-ending, it’s a massive blow to fantasy managers. Jameis Winston looked shell shocked for the majority of his snaps, a far cry from the Jameis we’ve come to know and love over the past few seasons. There are a few comforts we can take from his performance, one is the fact that top WR Malik Nabers hurt his shoulder and was playing through pain. The other is that he will not have to face the Rams pass rush again this season. He could still be a streaming option if Dart is out, but don’t start him right away as we want to see a bit more promise of a bounce back first.

news.body: Giants QB Jaxson Dart is believed to have suffered a sprained MCL based on the initial exams.
news.head: Jaxson Dart believed to have suffered sprained MCL
news.impact: Dart underwent X-rays that returned negative. He will undergo an MRI on Tuesday. He is expected to miss some time, but it appears he avoided anything too serious.

news.body: Jaxson Dart (knee) has been ruled out for the rest of the Giants' contest against the Rams on Monday night.
news.head: Jaxson Dart (knee) ruled out for rest of Monday Night Football
news.impact: Dart went down early in the first quarter against the Rams after getting sandwiched between two defenders. From the information on the broadcast, it does sound like Dart is OK, but he is being held out as they do further testing on his knee.

news.body: Jarden Daniels (elbow) will not be placed on IR.
news.head: Jayden Daniels (elbow) not going on IR
news.impact: Daniels has undergone multiple tests this week, and the Washington QB will avoid going on injured reserve. Instead, Daniels has been listed week-to-week with aim of getting back on the field as soon as possible. Backup quarterback Marcus Mariota is still expected to start in Week 3, but Daniels might be in play for Week 4.

news.body: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Jayden Daniels is seeing a specialist on Wednesday.
news.head: Jayden Daniels (elbow) seeing specialist Wednesday
news.impact: Quinn did not have an update on Daniels. There should be an update later this week.

news.body: Jayden Daniels underwent imaging on his dislocated elbow on Monday.
news.head: Jayden Daniels (elbow) undergoes imaging Monday
news.impact: Daniels is now slated to consult with a variety of experts over the next few days. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

news.body: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said QB Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow.
news.head: Jayden Daniels suffers dislocated elbow Sunday
news.impact: Daniels will undergo additional testing Monday. The X-Rays on Sunday showed no fracture. Marcus Mariota closed out Sunday's game for Washington.

news.body: Joe Burrow completed 28-of-37 passes for 282 yards and three touchdowns in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers. He rushed for 13 yards on two carries.
news.head: Joe Burrow tosses three touchdowns in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Burrow was excellent for the majority of the game Sunday, finding Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins, and Mike Gesicki for his three touchdown passes. The veteran did fumble on what would be the final drive for the Bengals, sealing the win for the Steelers. Burrow and the Bengals will welcome the Jaguars to town in Week 4.

news.body: Joe Burrow (back) is off of the injury report ahead of Week 3's matchup against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Joe Burrow (back) off injury report for Week 3
news.impact: Burrow was reportedly dealing with some soreness coming into the week, but it's not a serious issue and he carries no injury designation ahead of Week 3. He should be a full go against the Steelers, assuming he suffers no setbacks between now and then.

news.body: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor said Joe Burrow is dealing with soreness.
news.head: Joe Burrow dealing with soreness
news.impact: It is unclear how much Burrow will practice on Wednesday. He is day-to-day for now.

news.body: Joe Burrow completed 20-of-31 passes for 207 yards and two touchdowns in the Bengals 20-6 win over the Texans on Sunday.
news.head: Joe Burrow tosses two touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Burrow took five sacks, but he was able to avoid any turnovers with a pair of touchdown passes to Ja'Marr Chase. He'll look to keep it going against the Steelers in a Divisional matchup next week.

news.body: Jordan Love completed 28 of 53 passes for 312 yards with two touchdowns and a pick in the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons. He also ran once for no gain.
news.head: Jordan Love passes for 312 yards in loss
news.impact: Love was a bit up and down in this game. He was struggling against the pressure Atlanta was bringing, missing several forced throws and causing tipped passes. The Green Bay offense has no run game, which has worked out decently well for the pass catchers, but until they get things going on the ground to make the defense respect the run, it will be hard for the receivers and Love to have a ceiling week in, week out.

news.body: Jordan Love told reporters that his elbow injury is a non-issue for Week 3 against the Falcons.
news.head: Jordan Love says elbow is non-issue for Week 3
news.impact: Love said discomfort in his elbow went away before Jets game ended. He indicated the elbow is a non-issue for the Falcons game, even on a short week.

news.body: Jordan Love completed 16-of-29 pass attempts for 145 yards and two touchdowns in the Packers' 20-17 Week 2 win over the New York Jets.
news.head: Jordan Love tosses two touchdowns in Week 2 win over Jets
news.impact: Love continues a solid start to the season as part of a Green Bay offense battling inconsistency early on, throwing two touchdowns in each of the first two games. The quarterback will look for more sizeable success for fantasy managers in a favorable Week 3 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons.

news.body: Jordan Love completed 21-of-42 passes for 387 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in the Packers 39-22 loss against the Vikings.
news.head: Jordan Love throws for 387 yards Sunday
news.impact: Love tossed both touchdowns to Christian Watson as those two connected all afternoon. He did lose a fumble as the struggles began in the second half against the Vikings defense. He will face the Jets next week.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 16-of-26 pass attempts for 204 yards and two interceptions while also rushing eight times for 22 yards and two touchdowns with one fumble lost in the Bills' 24-16 Week 3 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Josh Allen reaches end zone on ground twice in Week 3 win over Chargers
news.impact: Allen made up for a mistake-filled day behind center rushing for two touchdowns for the third consecutive contests. The quarterback remains locked in as an elite dual-threat option behind center in all formats, with a Week 4 divisional matchup against the New England Patriots up next.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 20-of-31 passing attempts for 248 yards and three touchdowns while adding 69 yards and two touchdowns on the ground in Sunday night's 41-31 win over the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Josh Allen scores five touchdowns in dominant showing Thursday
news.impact: Allen had an insane showing on Thursday night. He totaled over 300 yards and scored five total touchdowns en route to a big win over the Lions in primetime, all while protecting the ball and committing zero turnovers. He has been absolutely dominant through the first two games of the season and is pacing to be one of, if not the most valuable individual player that anyone can roster at this point.

news.body: Josh Allen completed 20-of-29 passes for 334 yards with two touchdowns with an additional 23 yards and two scores on the ground on six carries in the Bills’ 36-31 win over the Texans on Sunday.
news.head: Josh Allen dismantles Houston defense in big win
news.impact: Allen was in complete control on Sunday, carving up what should have been a difficult Texans defense on his way to a four touchdown performance. He will have another nice matchup against Detroit on Thursday who just allowed a 30-point game to the Saints.

news.body: Josh Allen won't play in Thursday night's preseason finale against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
news.head: Josh Allen won't play Thursday
news.impact: Allen saw some action earlier on in the preseason, but he is set to be sidelined for the team's final preseason game on Thursday night. He is fully healthy at this point and looks primed for another huge season from a fantasy perspective.

news.body: Justin Herbert completed 20-of-34 pass attempts for 226 yards, one touchdown, and one interception while also rushing four times for 17 yards in the Chargers' 24-16 Week 3 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Justin Herbert struggles again behind center in Week 3 loss to Bills
news.impact: Herbert has struggled to make an impact behind center to begin the season, finishing with less than 230 passing yards in each of the first three contests. The quarterback will look to break out of his early season struggles as part of an underperforming Chargers offense against a tough Seattle Seahawks defense in Week 4.

news.body: Justin Herbert completed 15-of-27 passing attempts for 192 yards, one touchdown, and two interceptions in Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Justin Herbert struggles in loss Sunday
news.impact: Herbert didn't look very good on Sunday. He failed to hit 200 total yards and had more interceptions than touchdowns in what turned out to be a two-score loss at the hands of the Raiders, who are frequently regarded as one of the worst teams in the NFL. Los Angeles' offense has been spiraling through the first two weeks of the season, and it's not getting any easier for them with an absolute gauntlet of a schedule coming up over the next 7-9 weeks.

news.body: Justin Herbert connected on 17-of-27 passes for 209 yards with one touchdown and one interception, adding 29 yards on five carries in Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Cardinals.
news.head: Justin Herbert starts new season with mediocre performance
news.impact: Herbert and the Chargers' offense definitely disappointed under new OC Mike McDaniel on Sunday. This was expected by many to be an opening act for a dynamic offense against a sub-par defensive unit. It turned out to be anything but that. Herbert was sacked three times and picked off once while just clearing 200 yards on 27 throws. He did find top receiver Ladd McConkey for an eight-yard TD toss in the third quarter, but that was it as far as putting points on the board through the air. Herbert should still be viewed as a solid QB 1 going into a matchup with the Raiders, but if he disappoints again, the seventh-year pro will drop like a rock.

news.body: Justin Herbert and most of Los Angeles' starters will play in Thursday's preseason finale against the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Justin Herbert, starters will play Thursday
news.impact: HC Jim Harbaugh told reporters that Herbert and most of the team's starters are going to play in their final preseason game on Thursday night, with the exception of a few veterans. It remains unlikely that the starting unit will see more than a quarter or two of action, however.

news.body: Kyler Murray completed 15-of-29 passes for 168 yards with one touchdown and one interception in the Vikings 23-16 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
news.head: Kyler Murray has underwhelming day Sunday
news.impact: Murray was playing in his first game back from the concussion protocol. He lost Justin Jefferson early for the day. He targeted Jordan Addison heavily, including on a 41-yard touchdown. He'll face the Dolphins next week.

news.body: Kyler Murray has cleared concussion protocol and will start against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
news.head: Kyler Murray clears concussion protocol, will start Week 3
news.impact: Murray missed the Vikings Week 2 slog of a win over the Bears, but he will be back in the lineup for Week 3 against a hapless Tampa defense. Murray is still a bit of an unknown at this point given he barely played in Week 1, but this is a perfect matchup to return to.

news.body: Kyler Murray (concussion) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Kyler Murray (concussion) ruled out for Sunday
news.impact: Murray was progressing well through the NFL's concussion protocols this week, but he will ultimately have to end up missing a game due to the big hit that he suffered in Week 1. It looks likely that he will be back in time for Week 3, but Carson Wentz is expected to serve as Minnesota's starter in the meantime, which is good news for the fantasy value of Justin Jefferson in a prime matchup against the Bears this week.

news.body: Kyler Murray continues to progress through concussion protocol.
news.head: Kyler Murray progressing through concussion protocol
news.impact: Graziano notes that Murray did more in practice on Thursday than Wednesday. Once he is cleared, the Vikings will decide whether to start him on Sunday or play it safe by holding him out a week.

news.body: Lamar Jackson completed 21-of-31 passes for 235 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in the Ravens 24-17 loss to the Saints. He added 34 rushing yards on four carries.
news.head: Lamar Jackson held in check in Week 2 loss
news.impact: Jackson and the Ravens' offense appeared to feel the loss of Zay Flowers (hamstring) who was unavailable for this game. Jackson was intercepted on the final play of the game as the Ravens attempted a late comeback. The Ravens will take on the Cowboys in Week 3.

news.body: Lamar Jackson completed 17-of-25 pass attempts for 324 yards and one touchdown while also rushing seven times for 40 yards, one touchdown, and one lost fumble in the Ravens' 41-23 Week 1 win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Lamar Jackson surpasses 300 passing yards in Week 1 win over Colts
news.impact: Jackson took advantage of a more explosive offensive playbook from first-year offensive coordinator Declan Doyle, accounting for touchdowns on the ground and through the air in the win. The superstar quarterback remains an elite QB1 option entering a Week 2 matchup against the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Lamar Jackson will play without a contract extension to begin the season for the Baltimore Ravens according to Mike Garafolo.
news.head: Lamar Jackson to play without contract extension to begin season
news.impact: Jackson is focused on football entering the 2026-27 season under a new Baltimore Ravens coaching staff, as the superstar quarterback is poised for another elite season behind center barring injury while also offering fantasy managers explosive production as a high-level QB1 in all formats with an intriguing Week 1 contest against the Indianapolis Colts ahead.

news.body: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said Lamar Jackson will not play in the preseason opener on Saturday against the Eagles.
news.head: Lamar Jackson will not play in preseason opener
news.impact: Minter said there will be some “established players” not playing Saturday. Jackson should see some reps in the second or third preseason game.

news.body: Matthew Stafford completed 22-of-31 passing attempts for 327 yards, four touchdowns, and one interception in Monday night's 28-6 win over the New York Giants.
news.head: Matthew Stafford tosses four touchdowns in win Monday
news.impact: The reigning MVP had a great bounce-back game on Monday night after a disappointing season opener last week. He scored four touchdowns against the Giants and limited his mistakes overall, helping lead Los Angeles to a blowout win over New York. The only questions for him moving forward will be consistency and the health of his wideouts, with Puka Nacua (hip) currently out of the lineup for the Rams.

news.body: Matthew Stafford completed 15-of-25 passes for 155 yards and a pick in the Rams' 27-7 blowout loss to the 49ers. He also ran twice for a loss of a yard.
news.head: Matthew Stafford quiet in loss to Niners
news.impact: Stafford was not in his best form on Thursday, missing throws and looking a little rusty. It's a rough start for a team that was deemed Super Bowl-bound, but he will look to get back on track next week.

news.body: The Rams are expected to limit the reps for Matthew Stafford in training camp.
news.head: Matthew Stafford expected to have reps managed in training camp
news.impact: Stafford’s degenerative back issue cost him almost all of training camp last year, and he went on to have an MVP season. He is expected to have load managment once again throughout training camp as he enters another season.

news.body: Matthew Stafford has agreed to a one-year, $55 million extension with the Rams. He is now under contract for LA for the next two seasons.
news.head: Matthew Stafford agrees to one-year, $55 million extension
news.impact: The Rams are in a Super Bowl window, so this is hardly a surprising move. Stafford will give them the boost they need off of an MVP season to help them continue to compete for the next two years. As for Ty Simpson, it looks like he will be on the Jordan Love trajectory where we will need to wait at least two years to really get a shot as a starter.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes II completed 20-of-24 pass attempts for 246 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception while also rushing once for one yard in the Chiefs' 24-10 Week 3 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II tosses two touchdowns in Week 3 win
news.impact: Mahomes II continues a dynamic start to the season behind center, posting two or more touchdowns in each of the first three games. The superstar quarterback has turned back the clock for head coach Andy Reid to begin the season, with a Week 4 matchup against the Las Vegas Raiders up next.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes II completed 32-of-47 passing attempts for 382 yards and three touchdowns while adding 17 yards on the ground in Sunday night's 33-30 overtime win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II tosses three touchdowns Sunday
news.impact: Mahomes had an electric game on Sunday night, throwing three touchdowns and totaling nearly 400 yards en route to a narrow win over the Colts. He has been terrific since his return from injury and should be considered a worthwhile starter with week-to-week upside on any given week.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes II (knee) was listed as a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II (knee) listed as full participant Wednesday
news.impact: As expected, Mahomes continues to carry on at full health, logging a full practice session to start the week on Wednesday. Fantasy managers should have very few concerns with his premature return from injury at this point, since he demonstrated his health in Week 1 in Kansas City's big win over the Broncos.

news.body: Patrick Mahomes II completed 15-of-27 passing attempts for 184 yards, two touchdowns, and one interception while adding 23 yards and a touchdown on the ground in Monday night's 31-10 win over the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Patrick Mahomes II scores three touchdowns in return game Monday
news.impact: Monday night marked Mahomes' first game back after suffering a serious knee injury that ended his 2025 season prematurely.
